q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of polyhouse vegetables per kg?
title: Polyhouse farming emissions per kg
short: Add electricity for fans, cooling pads, fogging and pumps at 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, diesel for generators, and fertiliser N2O, then divide by kg harvested. Spread the plastic film and structure over their working life as bought-in inputs.

ul: Fertiliser, for N2O with IPCC defaults.
Polyhouse film, replaced every few years.
Seedlings, coco peat and growing media.

p: Divide by kg harvested per crop cycle, and report each crop separately, since tomatoes and capsicum yield very differently.

example.title: Worked example: one-acre polyhouse (one crop cycle, illustrative inputs)
lines: Add fertiliser N2O and the plastic film spread over its life for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your bills and harvest records.

senseible: Senseible reads diesel, electricity and fertiliser invoices into dated, fingerprinted records that support a farm or crop figure. Field emissions such as N2O and methane are calculated with IPCC defaults in your method note and labelled as estimates, not measured values.

sources.label: 2006 IPCC Guidelines, Volume 4 AFOLU, Chapters 10 and 11
